articles.title: Bitcoin appears to have decoupled from midterm cycle bottom history
articles.snippet: Previous bitcoin bear-market lows followed U.S. midterms, but this year’s recovery raises the possibility that the bottom arrived months earlier.

articles.title: Bitcoin consolidates after 3% loss as AI fears stoke fresh stock-market weakness
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price volatility cooled as stock markets battled another day of resurgent AI fears during Friday’s Asia trading session.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.

articles.title: Pentagon bans US forces from using military info to bet in prediction markets
articles.snippet: Hegseth warned that prediction market wagers could expose military operations to adversaries.

articles.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower
articles.snippet: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump’s comments on Iran military action.
